parallels.note: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

translations.web: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
translations.bsb: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
translations.kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
translations.asv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as angels in heaven.
